home.title: Everyday PDF tools, right in your browser
home.subtitle: Organize, merge, split, compress, sign and annotate PDFs. Works with Thai and other languages, with no sign-up.

common.privacy: Your files never leave your device
common.done: Done! Your file has been downloaded.
common.rangeHint: Leave empty for all pages, or enter e.g. 1-3, 5, 8-
common.missingChars: Some characters can't be drawn and were replaced with “?”: {{chars}}

dropzone.title: Choose a PDF file
dropzone.notPdf: Only PDF files can be used here.

errors.encrypted: This PDF is password-protected. Remove the password and try again.
errors.invalid: This file couldn't be opened. It may be damaged or not a PDF.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

editor.nothingSelected: Select an object to change it, or pick a tool to add something new.
editor.hint: Double-click text to edit it. Delete removes the selected object; arrow keys nudge it.
editor.noteDescription: Saved as a PDF comment that appears in the comments panel of PDF viewers.

organize.title: Organize pages
organize.hint: Drag pages to reorder them. Click to select several pages.
organize.keepOne: A PDF needs at least one page.

merge.title: Merge PDFs
merge.description: Combine several PDFs into one file.
merge.needTwo: Add at least two files to merge.

split.title: Split PDF
split.description: Divide a PDF into separate files.

modes.rangesHint: Choose exactly which pages go into each file.
modes.everyHint: Make a new file every N pages.
modes.singleHint: Make one file for each page.

split.rangesHint: Each comma makes a new file, e.g. 1-3, 4-6, 7

compress.title: Compress PDF
compress.description: Make a PDF smaller for email and upload.

levels.lightHint: Lossless clean-up. Smallest change in size.
levels.mediumHint: Shrinks large photos. Text stays sharp and selectable.
levels.strongHint: Turns pages into images. Smallest file.

compress.strongWarning: Strong compression turns every page into a picture. Text can no longer be selected, searched or copied.
compress.noGain: This PDF is already well compressed. Try a stronger level.

pageNumbers.title: Page numbers
pageNumbers.description: Add page numbers in any language.
pageNumbers.templateHint: {n} is the page number, {total} the last number.

watermark.title: Watermark
watermark.description: Stamp text or a logo across your pages.
watermark.textHint: Press Enter for a new line. Thai, Chinese, Arabic and other languages are supported.
watermark.imageHint: Drag the image into place and resize it. It's added at the same spot on every chosen page.

sign.title: Sign
sign.description: Draw, type or upload your signature.
sign.uploadHint: A PNG with a transparent background works best.
sign.saved: Saved on this device — click to place again

annotate.title: Annotate
annotate.description: Add text, highlights, shapes, drawings and comments.

feedback.title: Feedback
feedback.description: What would you like us to change or improve?
feedback.label: Your feedback
feedback.sent: Thanks! Your feedback has been sent.
feedback.error: Could not send your feedback. Please try again.
feedback.limited: Too many submissions. Please wait a minute and try again.
